reviews.t: Great eyelashes! Definitely will buy again (:
reviews.x: I wear fake eyelashes several times per week, and I love how natural these ones look! They extend and fill my natural eyelashes, and they are very easy to blend with the rest of my natural lashes!

I thought they were too simple at first.. BUT THEN After a full face of makeup and coating them with some mascara (not necessary) for a more dramatic look I loved! My eyes are on the smaller side and are hooded so it can be hard finding the perfect lash for my eye shape! There was no need in trimming which was another plus :) definitely ordering more packs!

My daughter and I tried the lashes out as soon as we got them.  We wore them when we went out and they were beautiful and natural looking lashes.  We love these and I would definitely buy them again.  They came with a nice eyelash tweezer too!
It gave the impression they just stuck on. They don’t and no glue included. Useless to me now.

reviews.t: Best falsies I’ve ever tried! And affordable!
reviews.x: I have been looking for affordable faux lashes as I was getting extensions but I never felt for all the money, that I just loved them. So I started looking and found Alice, which I won’t lie I immediately thought Alice in wonderland, which I’m a huge fan, and I’m so glad I chose this one!! They couldn’t be more perfect for me and I can get plenty of uses if you take care of them. I’ve even slept in them and woke up looking on point! I could go on for days about these and will continue to but the

I purchased these eyelashes so I didn’t have to wear mascara. I like them. They are easy to apply overall. My biggest struggle was getting the inside edge of lash to adhere and not lift. Overall happy with purchase and would purchase again.

I've tried different brands and types and they just don't compare to how nice these lashes look and last. I like them so much i just order my 3rd set. Price is so reasonable you can't go wrong with these lashes!

You must try these. I have used so many different lashes and glue. At $11 dollars for two boxes, the value is amazing. The band is very thin and delicate which made application a breeze! The easiest lashes I’ve ever applied. Both of my sisters could not take their eyes off my lashes and said they look great. I am SO thrilled I found these! I was just looking on Sephora and saw $28 dollar lashes (ONE pair) from Velour with mediocre ratings. I cannot imagine paying that kind of money for one pair
I get the most compliments when I wear these. I’ve been asked if they are my natural lashes or where I get extensions done. They stay on wonderful with the recommended lash glue. Beautiful.

reviews.t: Pretty Lashes, not too loud, perfect look!
reviews.x: These are my favorite lashes. Easy to put on, doesn't itch or break me out, and blends perfectly with my lashes.
I like them so much. They are so soft and neutral.

First, they're way too short. As you can see, they barely go halfway across my lash line.  Second, there is nothing to put glue on. The lashes are knotted around what looks like fishing line. The microscopic amount of glue that can be reasonably put on this plastic string is not enough to hold the lashes. I blink a few times, and the ends start to lift, a few more times, and they fall right off.  They're super lightweight, and they're not incredibly thick, which makes them look more natural than

These are my favorite eyelashes; i have been using them for months now! i usually reuse the same pair every day for an entire week and then switch them after that so they dont really get worn out that easily! Also, considering the clear and thin band on the eyelashes, it gives them a very comfortable feel and natural look, they arent irritating my eyes at all like other eyelashes. because they have a natural look, the lashes are not extremely dark either!

I could not apply these lashes to save my life! I trimmed them, switched glues.... did everything I could think of! I think the band is just too stiff! I have the extra box to a friend who is a pro and she had the same issue! Always pops up in the center. I worked them as much as I could and no give. I do not recommend! If you wear heavy eye liner you can get away with it. I wear NO eyeliner so I need a more pliable band!

Really great eyelashes. I keep reordering them because they're my favorite. They're very easy to apply and they look beautiful on your eyes. I apply them with eyelash glue and they hold all day. I even reuse them sometimes. They're super inexpensive and drugstore ones that are almost exactly the same would cost twice the money.

reviews.t: You Get What You Pay For
reviews.x: Although the lashes stick well and are light weight please understand you get what you pay for.  The curl in the lashes becomes straight when near heat or very warm place sike a warm room.  I usually buy Kiss or Ardell lashes and will continue to do so after my adventure with this brand.  I do not recommend purchasing.

reviews.t: Great price, very natural, very light
reviews.x: This is my first time wearing false lashes and I'm sold! These lashes are so light I dont even feel them on! The lash applicator that came with it was helpful too. Great value, natural looking and like I said extremely light weight. I will be back for more! Goodbye fiber lash mascara and any mascara for that matter!

reviews.t: Finally got falsies I can use!
reviews.x: I can never wear falsies! But I was actually able to wear these (with duo lash glue)! I don’t know if it’s the band or what, but I think that alone is worth it all!  I’ll only wear them for special events so this will last a long time. And if I somehow gain the guts to wear them more often, they’re a great deal.

I am not much of a regular user of fake lashes. I only wear them for special occasions.  I bought them because they were on sale and I would totally buy them again even at a full price. They are very natural yet just enough dramatic. Perfect lashes for girls that want that natural look finish.

These are my favorite go to lashes, they give that amazing full lash glamorous look. Glue is not included but you do get handy lash tweezers with every order. I have bought this product multiple times and keep ordering them due to all the compliments I get when I wear them.

I don’t wear false eyelashes all the time, only for special occasions so I’m not overly skilled and these were easy to apply and stayed put all evening.  I liked that they didn’t look overly fake with my own lashes, they just enhanced my eyes.

I'm fairly new to the eyelash scene, so I was looking for quality at a good value. I definitely found it with these lashes! They up my eyelash game, are realistic, and are easy (even being a novice like me) to apply. I highly recommend.

I love these because they are more natural, but give you that boost you want! People compliment me a lot more with these one. Also I’m wearing these and no foundation, it has given me the confidence to put down the foundation!

reviews.t: Good Eyelashes for a good price
reviews.x: These eyelashes are really nice, I love them. They are good quality, stay on your eyes , and are easy to apply! The tweezers that are included make the application easier, definitely my favorite part about this purchase.

These aren't horrible, but they did not work for me. They would not stick at all even after using a few different types of glue. Also they didn't really look great. Maybe they might work for others, but not for me

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these lashes for looking natural and blending well with their own lashes.
Many customers find the lashes easy to apply and comfortable to wear.
Reviewers repeatedly highlight the affordable price and good value, with several reordering.
A few reviewers report application problems, citing a stiff band or lack of a glueable surface.
Some customers were disappointed that no glue was included and that the lashes seemed to just stick on.
